entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Android] Editor and Entry don't update placeholder and text color on theme change #30602
  • [Android] SearchBar does not update colors on theme change #30600
  • [Android]MAUI带有触摸或手势识别器的控件无法在安卓原生悬浮窗IWindowManager正常工作 #30598
  • [iOS] SearchBar placeholder color is not updating on theme change #30596
  • MAUI Community Toolkit EventToCommandBehavior doesn't seem to be able to call RelayCommands #30595

Closed

  • [Label] Certain style attributes not applied when using Label.FormattedText #27828
  • Cannot select collectionview items when they have a tooltip on android emulator #30594

PullRequests

Created

  • [Android] Editor and Entry don't update placeholder and text color on theme change - fix #30603
    platform/android, community ✨, area-controls-entry, area-controls-editor
  • [Android] SearchBar does not update colors on theme change - fix #30601
    platform/android, community ✨, area-controls-searchbar
  • [housekeeping] Moved Issue28212.cs to a proper folder #30599
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-testing, community ✨
  • [iOS] SearchBar placeholder color is not updating on theme change - fix #30597
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-controls-searchbar

Updated

  • Further remove dependency of Compatibility.Layout on all modern .NET MAUI controls #29281
    t/breaking 💥, area-layout, .NET 10.0-preview7
  • [Android] Set FillViewport to true to MauiHorizontalScrollView #26904
    platform/android, community ✨, area-controls-scrollview, .NET 9 SR10
  • Implement SafeArea attached property for per-edge safe area control #30337
    p/0, .NET 10.0-preview7
